title: Approve mission and strategic direction
decision: Adopt the mission, vision, principles and scope boundaries in docs/01-vision/OUTPUT.md as the product direction
context: Candidate B was approved in DEC-001; Stage 01 turns it into an explicit direction centered on repayment, with lending, cross-shop data sharing and POS out of scope
rationale: Targets the only evidenced pain (EVID-001), avoids licensed activity (EVID-009), and keeps the MVP feasible; demand assumptions EVID-012 and EVID-013 remain to be tested in Stage 02
